npm arch:refresh.reason: Adoption runbook Step 7 has the consumer add arch:* aliases; storyline has them. The underlying symbol-index/refresh.mjs is synced, so the path form always works.

npm build.reason: Illustrative example of a consumer script name inside a doc snippet, not a command this bundle offers.

npm check.reason: The source repo pre-push aggregate. A consumer has its own test/verify entry point; the skills never depend on the aggregate existing.

npm dashboard:setup.reason: Alias chaining three synced scripts. Named as a source-repo convenience beside the per-path form a consumer runs.

npm debt:capture-trail.reason: Source-repo capture-trail check; debt-capture-trail-check.mjs is not in the sync closure.

npm debt:health.reason: Adoption runbook has the consumer add debt:* aliases; storyline has them. debt-health-check.mjs is synced.

npm docs:citations.reason: Already written as "source repo: npm run docs:citations -- <doc>" in the canonical verification-discipline reference.

npm fixture:create.reason: Pinned-revision worktree for spend-bearing runs in this repo.

npm gates:check.reason: Validates gate-contract.json files, which are never packaged or synced.

npm security:refresh.reason: Remaining mentions are prose EXPLAINING why the alias must not be used — the instruction beside them is the synced path.

npm skills:check.reason: Lints skills/** authoring invariants, which exist only in the source repo.

npm skills:hydrate.reason: The worktree-hydration alias. Every site already says "if this repo defines no such script, add this entry" and inlines a bare node+git bootstrap, so the text works with or without it.

npm skills:regenerate.reason: Regenerates .claude/skills/** from skills/**. Only the source repo owns skills/**; a consumer receives the generated half.

npm stores:drift.reason: Cross-store migration drift across every consumer — a source-repo operator command.

npm sync.reason: Run FROM the source repo to hydrate a consumer. Naming it inside consumer-facing text is telling the reader where to go, not what to run locally.

npm sync:dry.reason: Source-repo drift probe over every consumer. Meaningless in a consumer, which cannot see the other consumers.

npm upstream:queues.reason: Fans out over every consumer store; only the source repo has that registry.
